title: iPS cells: history made and history in the making
abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 29 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03116-8 The method to reprogram fully differentiated cells using transcription factors retools cells — and has retooled many a scientist’s trajectory.
